quest.title: Archon's Rival
quest.description: As Albedo suspected, this sword can absorb power to display a facsimile of "growth." This rare ability has caused it to catch the eye of certain parties with ulterior motives.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

chapter.num: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon: Act II
chapter.title: Archon's Rival

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Albedo!

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: You're back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haha! We've been working hard on the sword, you know? Check it out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm. Indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It is as I thought — this sword grows stronger as you use it in battle.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I thought that only applied to people.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: And that's precisely what makes it special.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Ah yes, I should mention a more important matter first.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I've investigated the area nearby, and I've discovered some unusual signs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's not more thieves, is it?

choices.text: But aren't we the real thieves here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I believe that these strange traces require investigation.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Whether it be thieves or something else, we shall investigate, and we shall find out.

choices.text: That's probably not how the Treasure Hoarders see things...

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: The Fatui? And they chose to attack us within the Treasure Hoarders' camp... Did they follow us here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But why would they do that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you go rile them up while we weren't looking?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Did you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, maybe it's something we all did, then...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I think the Fatui are looking for this sword.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh!? Weren't you keeping this sword super secret? How did they know it existed?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Perhaps they caught sight of you using it on the mountain.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If their eyes are any good, they'll definitely have seen how this sword stands out from the rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They really want everything, don't they?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Not quite, no.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I remember hearing more about their activities recently too...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: The Fatui are collecting things related to the archons. This, I believe, is known to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Now that you mention it, we did hear Master Diluc say that.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Durin is the sworn enemy of the Anemo Archon, and had power comparable to his.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: To say that it could rival the archons, or was related to them... Neither is an overstatement.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No wonder they've set their sights on this sword.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's how it is...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I made a new discovery while sketching nearby.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: There's an area up ahead that's quite remarkable. Its ley lines flow differently from any other.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Nearby monsters have been attracted to it and have fallen under its influence. As a result, their constitutions have come to far surpass others of the same kind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That seems convenient.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we're here to help this sword grow, aren't we? Might as well go try it out on those monsters!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Precisely my intention. Oh, and do remember to observe how various enemies affect this sword differently while you're at it, please.

choices.text: I wouldn't do something like that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lots of human activity here, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like more than one person, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Certainly seems like Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So they have a camp here... Hmph! Here to steal, just as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It would be rather convenient to rob adventurers who come up here, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's survival of the fittest here on this mountain, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All that stealing though, and still every last one of them's still poor as dirt...

choices.text: I wonder if we should feel sorry for them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Anyone who calls us thieves gets no pity from Paimon!
Who's that? Who're these sniveling sneaks snooping around our camp?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Argh, we're busted!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, how did it feel?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I have a hypothesis concerning this.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Each time this sword absorbs power from the bodies of fallen enemies, it will resonate with Durin's remains, hidden somewhere on this mountain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Holy moly, that sounds amazing!

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: If my theory proves correct, this could mean that all the monsters here may be resonating with Durin's body.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But why would they do that?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I fear this may have to do with the origin of these monsters' powers.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Durin is no ordinary beast. Even though it is long dead, the entire mountain is still held in thrall by its corpse.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: The dragon's mysterious power... may itself be a form of curse.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: We still don't have enough information. If we wish to understand more, more data is required. This is where you come in.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess story-time's become work-time...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I have some research work that needs settling, so we will have to work separately for now. Let's meet up again near the broken bridge.

choices.text: There are different responses... but there is an identical flow of energy.
